name: Bouncer
description: Real-time and batch email verification with normalized deliverability, risk, catch-all, disposable, role-account, and toxicity signals.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify one email synchronously. Returns deliverable, risky, undeliverable, or unknown plus reason, score, domain, account, DNS, and toxicity signals.

tools.name: verify_batch_sync
tools.description: Verify up to 10,000 email addresses synchronously through Bouncer's batch queue. Requests should be sent sequentially.

body.description: Raw JSON array of email addresses

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Verify one domain's MX, provider, catch-all, disposable, free, and toxicity signals.
